name: v0.3.19 — accordion view · purchase frequency · global search · product images
releaseNotes:
• Purchase-frequency label rendered below the price on every Stash card. Centrally computed via stashEngine#formatPurchaseFrequency — 'Weekly', 'Monthly', 'Every ~12d', 'Quarterly', etc. — so web + mobile word it identically.
• Stash gets a third view: accordion-by-category (📚 layers icon next to Grid + List). Each category collapses to a header with item count; opens to a mini grid. Only fires when 'All' is selected — picking a specific category implies a flat list, and search results stay flat too.
• Search box is now GLOBAL — typing in search bypasses the active category filter so you find any item without picking the right pill first.
• 'Tap to count' empty-state pill removed from cards. ⋮ menu's stepper still lets you count when you want. Once counted, the pill reappears as 'N on hand'.
• Web Stash cards now show real product images (cauliflower, mint, etc.) via /api/product-image-batch — falls back to category emoji when no image found.
• Central stash engine extended with selectStashView, groupByCategory, formatPurchaseFrequency — single source of truth for the rules across web + mobile.
